1479-2841-4201-8337.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Cabaretti Courtyard.
1479-2841-4201-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Cabaretti Courtyard.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

574-1981-2415-2842.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-2842.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

539-3821-3899-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-3899-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat

301-4738-5961.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-3010-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3010-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-7730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

713-2292--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

1027-7611-7612.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus {X}, where {X} is Jackal's power minus {1}
1027-7611-7612.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
1027-7611-7612.description:
Cast Wildwood Scourge by paying {G} plus an additional amount of mana equal to Jackal's power minus {1}.
Jackal triggers, copying the Wildwood Scourge spell and putting a +1/+1 counter on Jackal.
Resolve both Wildwood Scourge spells.
Cast Ego Erasure by paying {2}{U}, targeting yourself.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Wildwood Scourge.
The other Wildwood Scourge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat step 6 infinitely.

710-2511-7424.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3480-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
3480-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3480-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

891-1703-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

240-1322-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

1144-1682-2645-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

643-4338-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3259-5722-6791.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-6791.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

1170-1645-5478-5954-6751.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-4863.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Revolutionist with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Revolutionist token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

488-1492-2895-3200-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Urza's Bauble or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1492-2895-3200-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2793-3743-4365-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
392-2793-3743-4365-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Harnfel by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

478-2821-3918-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Your devotion to blue is at least six.
Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3918-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
2438-5972-5973.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

703-1430-2896.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attaching Necromancy to Astral Dragon.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Necromancy tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, with at least one trigger targeting Mirror Image.
Resolve the first Necromancy trigger, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Astral Dragon, and not attaching Necromancy to Mirror Image due to Necromancy being a creature.
The Necromancy Aura creature token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to being an Aura that is unattached.
The Necromancy token leaves-the-battlefield ability triggers, as well as Mirror Image's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Necromancy trigger, causing you to sacrifce Mirror Image.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 4.

418-1339-1636.notablePrerequisites: Ocular Halo attached to a creature you control without summoning sickness.
418-1339-1636.description:
Activate the creature with Ocular Halo attached by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1082-2781.notablePrerequisites: You control and own at least one mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped.
1082-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature's first ability.
Resolve Felidar Guardian's ability, blinking a mana-producing permanent you control.
Activate that permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve Dual Nature's first ability, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian.
When the token Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
When the Felidar Guardian leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers Dual Nature's second ability, Dual Nature's first ability, and its own ability.
Resolve Dual Nature's second ability, exiling all tokens named Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any permanents you control any number of times in step 3.

198-1358-1978.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Sydri.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1358-1978.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

4050-4215-5209.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldspire Wurm, adding one mana of any color.
Worldspire Wurm dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Worldspire Wurm trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Worldspire Wurm, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
